==Acquisition==
'''[[Skill quest]]s'''
*[[The Big Unfriendly Jotun]] (from [[Undrath Blastrock]] in [[Sifhalla]])

==Notes==
*Useful with stances that have a longer [[recharge time]] than duration. For example:
**[[Dash]] or [[Pious Haste]] as a [[speed boost]]
**[[Dark Escape]], [[Dwarven Battle Stance]], and [[Lightning Reflexes]] become more suitable for [[PvE]].
*If you would like to have the added benefits of Dwarven Stability ''without'' the screen effects of being drunk open the game options menu and on the graphics tab uncheck "Enable post process effects".
*The use of one 1 point [[alcohol]] just before you activate the skill is enough to trigger the bonus effects.

{{anomaly|If recast before the duration ends, Dwarven Stability will end before being reapplied, triggering [[Meditation]] and other relevant skills.}}
{{anomaly|This skill has no [[aftercast delay]].}}
